_comment: Release setting. Set apiBaseUrl to the real production API (https://<host>/api) BEFORE running `pnpm dist:win` to pre-configure installers. Leave empty to make first launch show the Server Setup screen. Never put credentials here; a user's own saved Server settings always take precedence. updateFeedUrl is the no-server update host: a folder of signed release files, published by pnpm send-update.
